patterns: APPSC asks concept-identification one-liners: key factor of Western model (economic growth), non-economic factor (corruption), sustainable growth definition, who coined 'Hindu rate of growth' (Raj Krishna).
Sustainable development / Brundtland definition is the single most repeated item across APPSC papers (G1, 2023 lecturers, screening tests).
Economist-theory attribution (Nurkse - vicious circle, Sen - capability) and index components (HDI excludes urbanisation; PQLI = IMR + literacy + LE at age one) are the standard traps.
AP-specific items appear (AP Economic Development Board Act 2018); 'Limits to Growth' asked twice.
App MCQs are broader and more statement-heavy (curves, ICOR, CPI/WPI/IIP agencies, Swarna Andhra figures) than the direct definitional PYQs.
